title: Platelet-related extracellular vesicles: Therapeutic roles in musculoskeletal disorders

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Platelet-related extracellular vesicles: Therapeutic roles in musculoskeletal disorders》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-2】Platelet-rich plasma (PRP) has been widely investigated for musculoskeletal repair, and interest has increasingly extended to extracellular vesicle (EV) preparations obtained from platelet-related starting materials.
